chunks: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him belongs the judgement forever. So will you fear any other than God?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God's judgement is 'wasi'ban' (everlasting/continuous)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Rububiyyah* (Divine Lordship), affirming that God’s dominion over the heavens and earth is absolute and unchallenged. The term *al-Din al-Daim* (the eternal religion/judgement) highlights the permanence of divine authority, serving as a theological basis for directing all acts of worship and reverence exclusively to Allah. This reinforces the practical implication of *Ikhlas* (sincerity), urging believers to transcend fear of created powers and anchor their devotion solely in the Creator.
